turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: I came in because I just feel... flat inside. Even when my children sit with me, or when the sun is out on my garden, I can’t seem to feel glad or comforted by it. It’s like that part of me has just shut off.

symptom_reasoning.S076: The patient describes feeling flat and unable to feel glad or comforted even during ordinarily positive experiences with her children or garden.

turns.doctor_question: Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, spending time with family, or going outside?
turns.patient_response: Yes… I suppose I have. Even when my children come sit with me, or I go out and see the sun on my garden, I don’t really feel anything from it. I used to feel comforted by things like that, but now I just feel flat inside, like that glad feeling has shut off.

symptom_reasoning.S076: The patient reports feeling emotionally flat and unable to feel gladness or comfort from previously comforting time with her children and garden.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling tired or have you noticed a lack of energy most days?

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions lately?
turns.patient_response: Yes. I used to be able to plan meals and keep my calendar straight, but lately I just… I stare at a grocery list or the senior center schedule and my mind goes blank. I can’t seem to decide even simple things, so my daughter has been helping me with them.

symptom_reasoning.S031: The patient reports recent mind-blanking when reviewing lists or schedules, difficulty making simple decisions, and needing her daughter's help.
